additional_info.subject: Issue:-
additional_info.body: We very often have the problem with our new Mercedes eActros that charging processes interrupt. Unlike Ivecos, the charging processes start normally, but they are sometimes interrupted after 3 minutes, sometimes after 30 minutes. The cause is unclear. When it happens, it often happens 2-3 times in a row, so sometimes the vehicles aren't fully charged by the start of the shift. These interruptions don't occur while on the move. At first, we thought this was an isolated incident, but now we've observed long enough and are seeing this phenomenon across the board with several eActros.

additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph,
Thank you very much for your fast reply.
The right charging point seems to be working properly. There is a charging session as we speak:
Regarding the Mercedes topic, we are currently exchanging information with Mercedes, we were able to reproduce the issue in another depot and analysing the logs.
For now I can recommend updating the charger to v8.0.5 which mitigates this problem.
What does this mean in general? This means that whenever a session is interrupted, the eActross is able to restart the session after a few minutes by itself and the session is then again restarted.
This is a workaround that we have for now, while we are investigating together with Mercedes.
Do I have your permission to install v8.0.5? Also, if this problem happens in all chargers then I recommend updating all of them.
Thank you!

additional_info.subject: ID0451704-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002836] Charging process interrupted CRM:03055000003
additional_info.body:
Hi Sascha, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Breilmann KG is opening tickets every time that the eActros has a charging interruption. From the Vehicle Integration team I share with you our latest update:
This is a well known issue between the Daimler eActros and the SiCharge D. The issue has been observed in several regions always with this combination of vehicle charger. the issue is being investigated by the Daimler team from France and the Daimler HQ team in Germany.
The investigation is ongoing, but we have been able to estimate with great certainty the cause of the charging interruptions so far these are cause by the HV-lufter the Daimler eActros 600 has incorporated in their system. This issue does not occur with other Daimler eActros models, neither with other OEMs. So technically what is causing the resonance interference in the CP lined which ends up in charging sessions getting interrupted is the vehicle. However, it seems that the Sicharge D 300 has higher sensibility to this interference generated by the vehicle than other chargers do (even possible that the sicharge D Gen 2 is not as sensitive to this interference as the SiCharge D 300, this is also under investigation).
Since the source of the interference is located on the vehicle side, updating to V8 will have no positive neither negative impact.
This is a topic where our R&D and PLM teams are involved and we are working jointly with Daimler HQ to find a solution for our common customers.
It would be helpful to keep track of all sites and customer where similar issues are observed and notify to the customers that we are working on a solution together with Daimler and are working towards having it as soon as possible.
Can you please convey this information to the customer and I will close this ticket? Since we already have ticket number ID0445089 for the same customer, same behaviour.
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco

My name is Francisco and I'm from the special team for the e-Actros problem.
We agreed to install a SECC version that mitigated this issue in 2 chargers
170002840 and 170002839
, at 21th November, and after >1 month of daily monitoring, we have not found any error related to abortion of charging sessions.
Internally, we have agreed that since the error is mitigated, we will close the ticket and if you wish to have this update for the other charging stations, please open a new ticket refering our team to install the SECC eActros version.
If you find another charging abortion, please inform us again.
I wish you a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM VI
additional_info.body:
10/Sep - Ingo will go to Daimler this week to perform tests. Daimler acknowledges that the airpump is creating this noise but is not going to change anything. Other chargers seem to be more robust to these changes.
27/Oct - Ingo & Peter from EcoG will go to Daimler Worth on 28th Oct
12/Nov - New EcoG layer to be announced as 1.7.1 seems to have worked once with the noise induction. New findings to be provided by Daimler as tests continue
21/Nov - Installed EcoG 1.7.1 in chargers Pipwyj and Tmbk2s
3/Dec - No ERR67 found in both chargers related to CurrentDemand
30/Dec - No Err67 since last reported
